Orrin.hail.outer: Got the key? Good. Tallow's on the far side, and that warp doesn't run back until you're through.
Orrin.hail.outer.after: Finish what you owe around here first. The tender's free if you're dented. I'll keep the board.
Orrin.hail.section: Market district is away. Mira wants a receipt.|Repair quarter, lifting. Hal's holding a bench down with his foot.|Residential crescent is clear. Somebody's left a kettle on.|Tug dock, go. That's the last of us.

Taren.swap: My turn to be unreasonable.|I've got it. Breathe.|Stepping in.
Taren.low: The seams are getting warm.|That one got through.|I'm running out of plating.
Taren.teach.flash: Watch the mark fill. Dodge just before it lands and everything slows for you.
Taren.teach.swap: Swap me in when it gets tight. I come in swinging and you get to breathe.
Taren.teach.guard: Guard right as it lands. You take nothing, gain Charge, and your next hit bites.
Taren.teach.extra: Your gauge is full. Spend it all at once. Nothing touches you while it lasts.
Taren.extra: Stand clear. This is the loud part.|Anvil Chorus. Mind your ears.
Taren.zone: Same body. Different problem.|New ground. Same job.|Let's see what's broken here.|Stay close. I mean it.
Taren.cover: Stay down a second. I've got this.
Taren.discovery: A nursery for routes. Orrin's going to want that in writing.
Taren.bossphase: It's changing its mind. Watch the ground.
Taren.bossbraced: It's braced on the organs. Break them!
Taren.beacon: One less voice calling them in.
Taren.zone.flight: Same body. Different problem.|Clear lanes. Stay sharp.|Let's see what's broken out here.
Taren.bossphase.HessaKorl: She's calling her crew. Watch the ground.
Taren.bossopening.Cantor: The collar slacks each time its song ends. Cut it then!
Taren.bossphase.Cantor: It's changing its song. Watch the lanes.
Taren.bossphase.Seedthane: It's pulled its legs up and it's circling. Watch the fans.
Taren.bossopening.Seedthane: A leg's gone. It's listing. Now!
Taren.bossphase.Floodcrown: Basin's dry and it's faster. Keep off the puddles.
Taren.bossopening.Floodcrown: It's caught in its own wave. Break a flood gate!
Taren.barge: She's drifting clear. That's cover now.|Loose. Keep her between us and them.|Free. Mind the weed on the way round.
Taren.tag: One of Hulljack's tags, gone.|Unclaimed again.|That's his paperwork lighter.
Taren.anchor: Hold on to something.|There it goes again.|Same island. Different doors.
Taren.pods.red: Red ones. They bite, she said.
Taren.pods.yellow: Yellow. I'm not thinking about it.
Taren.bossphase.Rotbloom: The hall's draining. It's grounded. Watch the floor.
Taren.bossopening.Rotbloom: Stalk's burned. A mouth's open. Now!
Taren.glow: We're lit. Going dark.|Too bright. Coast.
Taren.swarm: Swarm on me. Rolling it off.
Taren.tune: Back in time. Two short, one long.|That's the pair. Both keeping time.
Taren.lure: No long. That one's a mouth.|It never finished the count. Blades out.
Taren.leech: Marked water. Leeches. Take the dry way.
Taren.pump: Water's dropping. Watch the alcoves.|There it goes. Somebody built that to last.
Taren.bossphase.Hulljack: It's lurching to another join. Watch the booms.
Taren.bossphase.DessikVarn: He's throwing the cargo. Watch the circles.
Taren.bossopening.DessikVarn: The suit's kneeling. Hit the cockpit!
Taren.foot: A foot's off. It's lurching.|Another one cut. Watch where it lands.|It's running out of feet.
Taren.breach: That's the cabin alarm. We can't leave him standing. Finish it!
Taren.bossphase.HostMarshal: Last coupling's gone. It's slowing. Watch the floor.
Taren.bossopening.HostMarshal: It's calling the wall. Break a coupling!
Taren.current: Wrong way. It's bleeding us.|Cross to the bright lane.
Taren.thaw: The ice has gone amber. They're stepping out.
Taren.coupling: Coupling's gone. Feel that cold.|Second one. The wall's stopping.|That's the last. Up.
Taren.stray: Easy. Walk with us.|That's it. Home's this way.|Last one. Hask can stop counting.
Taren.lamp: Lit, from the low flame.|Second one. Mind the drop.|That's all three.
Taren.rail: Lights are running green. Go.|Amber. Tuck in behind the moon.|Green again. It keeps better time than I do.
Taren.rail.forced: We forced that one. The rails are waking up.
Taren.moonshard: That moon's shedding. Keep off the marked track.
Taren.lift: Down's that way now. Step on.|It carries. Don't fight it.|Same as a hoist. Stand in the middle.
Taren.junction.cut: Cut. Mind your feet.|Down it goes. Quick, at least.
Taren.junction.seat: Seated. Up she comes.|Collar's home. Hear the glass ring?
Taren.garden: We've broken their bed. Here come the shears.
Taren.wisp: That fibre's lit. Off it. Now.
Taren.glassback: It's shed its plates. Watch the floor.
Taren.sentinel: It throws your shot straight back. Get round the side.
Taren.tender: It's closing my clamp. Stop it first.
Taren.clamp: Taking its weight. Cover me.|Weight's mine. Waiting on the slack.|It's easing. Cover me.|Last one. Then together.
Taren.mend: Seated. Its light's come up.|Second one. It's raking already.|Third. It's off. I think we follow.
Taren.bossphase.LastWarden: Fewer lines, more floor. Watch which one brightens.
Taren.bossopening.LastWarden: Staff's down. Clamp. I'll take the weight.
Taren.picket.amber: Buoys have gone amber. They've a scent of us.
Taren.picket.hunters: Hunter wing's out. Lances. Don't fly straight.
Taren.picket.carrier: The carrier's turning. That's all of it awake.
Taren.shadow: In the rock's shadow. Hold here.|Dark again. Next rock.
Taren.flak: The curtain fires on a count. Go on the gap.
Taren.lancer: Lance run, down the marked line. It turns slow after.
Taren.lock: Port collar. Off.|Starboard. Off.|Keel collar. Off.|Bar's out. It's open.
Taren.crust: Seam's glowing. Off it.|Dark crust. That holds.
Taren.flow: Burnt. It threw me back. Don't do that.
Taren.squall: Ash coming. Stand still till it clears.
Taren.pikeguard: Two pikes. One braces, one covers. Split them.
Taren.mortar: Slag shell, on the marked ring. It burns after.
Taren.message: Under the kettle stone. Nobody saw.|Second one's left.|That's the third. Read it, burn it, deny it.
Taren.sluice: Sluice is open. The pour's gone dark.|Second sluice. Mind the press.|Third. Its plate's cooling.
Taren.pour: Pour drone on the rail. Off the marked strip.
Taren.arm: One pour-arm off.|Both arms. It's coming apart.
Taren.glass: One plate. Wrap it.|Two. Aumi's going to count them.|That's the last. They're going home.
Taren.kitchen.kettle: A kettle, stamped. I could have mended hers.
Taren.shout: Two pikes in. Split them.|One pike.|Just him.
Taren.harbour: Guns are marked on the water. Stay off the marks.
Taren.bossphase.VessaKorl: She's pulling back to the heart. Don't follow her blind.
Taren.bossphase.SlagColossus: Arms are off. It's shedding plate. Watch the floor cool.
Taren.bossopening.SlagColossus: That plate's gone dark. Hit the dark.
Taren.bossphase.DraskVaal: He's stopped being polite with that lance.
Taren.bossphase.DraskSkiff: He's cut for the carrier. Through the cranes.
Taren.bossopening.DraskSkiff: Lance run's done. He's turning wide. Now.
Taren.spiral: Inward's quicker. Mind what's in it.|Out on the wide turn. Slow, and nothing's coming.
Taren.towdrone: That drone's still towing for a berth that's gone. Cut its line.
Taren.fragment: Cage piece, on a tether. It sweeps. Count it and cross.
Taren.wreck: Hull colours. That's a family's.|Somebody painted that hatch by hand.|Lamp's lit. They're in there.
Taren.dawn: Light's on the ridge behind us. Move.|It's at our heels. Don't look round.|That's the plating getting hot. Go.
Taren.remate: First coupling's home.|Second. She's taking load.|Third. Drive her.
Taren.scavenger: Burrower, along the light. It lunges. It hates shade.
Taren.gull: Slag gull. Off the ring before it spits.
Taren.joint: Weight's off. She's opening.|That one's mine. I shut it nine times.|Open. Good.
Taren.override: Compact rig, on our own machine. Knock it off.
Taren.weldarm: That's my welding arm, under somebody else's hand. Off the strip.
Taren.warden: Compact crew. They'll give ground. Let them.
Taren.saint.arm: Collar's released. Arm's down, not broken.|Second arm. Let it rest.|Third. There's the rig, on its back.
Taren.bossphase.FoundrySaint: Rig's showing. Up the arms. It's still swinging the rest.
Taren.bossopening.FoundrySaint: Head's up. Shoulder collar. Take its weight.
Taren.interceptor: Pair of them. One pins, one shoots. Break the line.
Taren.pod: One pod dark.|Two. It's flying lopsided.|That's all three. It's only a hull now.
Taren.section: That's the repair quarter going by. Hal's light is on.|Residential crescent. Somebody's waving.|There goes the tug dock.
Taren.bossphase.DebrisCutter: It's changed how it hunts. Watch the channels.
Taren.bossopening.DebrisCutter: It's turning wide round the market. Now.
Taren.consign.nacre: Crate's sound. Two names on the lid, both in ink.
Taren.consign.crawl: Lent for a season. That was nine years ago. Still wrapped.
Taren.bench.ket: Ket's got it open before I've put it down.
Taren.bench.lo: Lo says thank you. Lo also says go away.
Taren.bench.marn: Marn's lit it. Didn't need me.
Taren.parcel.tug: For the Welcome Back. She says put it with the others. There are no others.
Taren.parcel.crawl: Handed over at a walk. Nobody stopped.

Sela.swap: Try to keep up, Vosk.|My turn. Watch and learn.|Move over. I'm bored.
Sela.low: That was a load-bearing piece!|Ow. Rude.|I'd like a refund on this plating.
Sela.kill: Beautifully uncomplicated.|Noted and deleted.|That one won't be filing a complaint.|You're welcome, Vosk.
Sela.teach.flash: See that mark fill, Vosk? Dodge just before it lands and the world slows for you.
Sela.teach.swap: Swap me in when it gets ugly, Vosk. I land hitting and you get to breathe.
Sela.teach.guard: Or guard right as it lands, Vosk. No damage, free Charge, and your next hit bites.
Sela.teach.extra: That gauge is full, Vosk. Let it all go at once. Nothing can touch you while you're showing off.
Sela.extra: Everybody look up!|Lattice Aria. Try to keep time.
Sela.gate.open: Curtain's coming down, Vosk. That door only opens for people who relight things.
Sela.zone: I vote we touch nothing. Yet.|Smells like old solder and bad decisions.|Nice place. Who broke it?|Nobody panic. That's my job.
Sela.cover: Hold still, Vosk. I'm covering you.
Sela.discovery: Note for the survey: not empty. Not even slightly.
Sela.bossphase: New rhythm. Read the floor, Vosk.
Sela.bossopening: There's your opening. Don't admire it.
Sela.bossbraced: It's leaning on those organs, Vosk. Break them first.
Sela.beacon: Quiet. That one won't call anything else in.
Sela.zone.flight: I vote we touch nothing. Yet.|Pretty. That usually means trouble.|Nobody panic. That's my job.
Sela.bossphase.HessaKorl: She brought friends. Read the floor, Vosk.
Sela.bossopening.HessaKorl: There's your opening. Don't admire it.
Sela.bossopening.Cantor: The collar slacks when its song ends. Cut it then, Vosk.
Sela.bossphase.Cantor: New rhythm. Read the current, Vosk.
Sela.bossphase.Seedthane: It's up and circling, Vosk. Read the fans.
Sela.bossopening.Seedthane: It's listing, Vosk. There's your opening.
Sela.bossphase.Floodcrown: Dry floor, faster crown. Mind the puddles, Vosk.
Sela.bossopening.Floodcrown: It's open. Go for a gate on the rim, Vosk.
Sela.barge: It's drifting back into the lane. Fly behind it, Vosk.|A barge between us and them. I'll take it.|Loose. One more thing to hide behind.
Sela.tag: Unclaimed. Again.|Somebody's paperwork just got lighter.|I'd like to see them file that.
Sela.anchor: It's walking. Check the doors, Vosk.|New doors. I'll redraw it.|Same halls, new exits. Keep up.
Sela.pods.red: Red pods. If I cry, Vosk, it's the spice.
Sela.pods.blue: Blue pods, in the shade, sulking. She wasn't joking.
Sela.pods.yellow: Yellow pods. We don't think about it. We pick.
Sela.bossphase.Rotbloom: It's beached and thrashing, Vosk. Mind the cracks.
Sela.bossopening.Rotbloom: There's a mouth open, Vosk. Don't admire it.
Sela.glow: We're glowing, Vosk. Count two.|Dark. Seams and all.
Sela.swarm: They're on me. Rolling them off.
Sela.tune: Two short, one long. Keeping time.|That's the second. Maru can stop watching.
Sela.lure: Short, short, nothing. Not a lamp, Vosk.|It can't hold the long. Lure.
Sela.leech: Something's in that channel. Go round.
Sela.pump: Draining. Something always wakes, Vosk.|Listen to that. Quill would cry.
Sela.bossphase.Hulljack: New join. Different cover. Move, Vosk.
Sela.bossopening.Hulljack: It's put a foot down, Vosk. That one.
Sela.bossopening.DessikVarn: It's down on a knee. Cockpit, Vosk.
Sela.foot: One foot gone. It hates that.|Cut. It's hopping to the next join.|It can't hold on with what's left, Vosk.
Sela.breach: That's the cabins, Vosk. End this.
Sela.bossphase.HostMarshal: Its heat's failing, Vosk. It hits harder. Mind the cracks.
Sela.current: Against the light, Vosk. Get across.|It's turning. Jump lanes.
Sela.whiteout: Here it comes. Vent pocket. Now.
Sela.thaw: Another rank's awake. Three at a time, Vosk.
Sela.coupling: That's a third of them back to sleep.|Two. The cold's coming up behind us, as briefed.|Three. Don't tell her I counted.
Sela.stray: Hum, Vosk. It likes you flat.|It's following. Don't look pleased.|One more for Hask to count twice.
Sela.lamp: It's caught. Iru will see that from the pens.|Second lamp. So that's the whole ice ring.|Three. She'll have to tell Tern now.
Sela.rail: Green. Go, Vosk.|Amber. Sit in the moon's lee and look harmless.|Green. Keep its time and it keeps the peace.
Sela.rail.forced: We jumped its count. The rails have noticed.
Sela.moonshard: That's the Clerk of Roads coming apart. Off the marked track.
Sela.clamp: I have its weight.|Waiting.|Slack. Opening.|Last one.
Sela.mend: Its light's up.|It's raking.|It's leaving. Follow it.
Sela.picket.amber: Amber. They've half heard us, Vosk. Go quiet.
Sela.picket.hunters: Hunter wing. So much for quiet.
Sela.picket.carrier: Carrier's coming about. We're as loud as it gets.
Sela.shadow: Shadow. Breathe.|Dark. They chart well. Not this well.
Sela.flak: It fires in a pattern. Read it, then thread it.
Sela.lancer: Lancer, lining up. Off the mark, then hit it on the turn.
Sela.lock: One off. Hunters, high. I have them.|Two.|Three. Keep going, Vosk.|It's open.
Sela.flow: It threw me back. I'd rather not do that twice.
Sela.squall: Ash. I can't see my own hands. Wait.
Sela.pikeguard: They cover each other. Take one off the other.
Sela.mortar: Shell coming down on the ring. The ground stays hot.
Sela.message: Under the stone. Nobody looked up.|Two. Somebody's kettle is on.|Three. That's a family told.
Sela.sluice: Flooded. There's a way across.|Second one. That press is live now.|Third. Its plate's going dark.
Sela.arm: An arm's off.|No arms. Look at it try.
Sela.glass: First plate. It's still clear.|Second. They never even cleaned the card.|Third. Home, all of you.
Sela.kitchen.salt: Salt, with a stamp I'm not looking at.
Sela.kitchen.flour: Flour. It weighs what a child does.
Sela.shout: Two came. Mind the flanks.|One.|He's alone out there.
Sela.harbour: The guns show on the water. Fly the gaps.
Sela.bossphase.VessaKorl: She's spending the gallery. She said she would.
Sela.bossopening.VessaKorl: Her lance has run dry. Go.
Sela.bossphase.SlagColossus: It's lost its arms and it's still walking. Mind the slag.
Sela.bossphase.DraskVaal: He's faster. He was being courteous before.
Sela.bossopening.DraskVaal: He's open. Don't make me say it twice.
Sela.bossphase.DraskSkiff: He's running for the carrier. Under the cranes, Vosk.
Sela.bossopening.DraskSkiff: He's wide on the turn. Now.
Sela.spiral: Inward, if you're in a hurry. I always am.|The wide turn. Dull. Alive.
Sela.towdrone: It's hauling a wreck to a door that's gone. Somebody tell it.
Sela.fragment: That's a piece of the cage, still thrashing. Time the sweep.
Sela.wreck: That's a household's colours, Vosk.|Children's drawings on that port.|There's a lamp. Somebody's keeping it lit.
Sela.dawn: Sunrise, Vosk. The bad kind.|It's gaining. Faster.|I can feel it through the hull. Go, go.
Sela.remate: One mated.|Two. She's taking it.|Three. Drive, somebody drive.
Sela.scavenger: It hunts along the light. Get it into shade.
Sela.gull: Above. It's going to spit. Move off the ring.
Sela.joint: It's opening. Listen to it.|Another one of yours, Vosk.|Open.
Sela.override: That's her rig on your press. Take it off.
Sela.weldarm: Welding line, marked strip. Over it.
Sela.warden: They're backing off. They don't want this either.
Sela.saint.arm: It's let go. It's resting.|Two down. Gently.|Three. The rig's bare.
Sela.bossphase.FoundrySaint: The rig's up top. Climb the arms, Vosk.
Sela.bossopening.FoundrySaint: Its head's lifted. The shoulder. Now.
Sela.interceptor: Two. One holds you still for the other. Cut the line.
Sela.pod: One pod gone.|Two. It's guessing now.|Three. It can't touch us.
Sela.section: That's the market going past. With Mira on it.|The crescent. Every window's lit.|Tug dock's away.
Sela.bossphase.DebrisCutter: It's hunting differently. Read it again.
Sela.bossopening.DebrisCutter: It's swung wide of the crescent. Now.
Sela.consign.nacre: Somebody's whole kitchen, crated. It floated.
Sela.consign.crawl: They lent it to a town that never stops. Brave.
Sela.bench.ket: Ket had it unfolded before we stopped.
Sela.bench.lo: Lo's set it up on a floor that's moving. Of course.
Sela.bench.marn: Marn didn't look up. That's a yes.
Sela.parcel.tug: One parcel, for a tug. She signed with a thumb.
Sela.parcel.crawl: Delivered. I had to walk backwards to do it.

Idra.low: Plating's thin. Noted.|That got through. It won't twice.|I've had worse. Not often.
Idra.teach.flash: Watch the mark fill. Move just before it lands and you get time. Spend it.
Idra.teach.swap: When it's too much, call me in. I arrive braced. You rest.
Idra.teach.guard: Brace as it lands. You take nothing, and it takes the shock back.
Idra.teach.extra: Gauge is full. Spend all of it. Nothing touches you while it lasts, so stand where it matters.
Idra.extra: Last One Out. Behind me.|Clear the door. I'm coming through.
Idra.release: It's open. Stand clear and let it go.
Idra.zone: New ground. Same rules.|Exits first. Then the rest.|Stay where I can count you.|I've pulled people out of worse.
Idra.discovery: That's not on the brief. Mark it.
Idra.bossphase: It's changed. So do we. Watch the floor.
Idra.bossbraced: It's bracing on those. Break them first.
Idra.zone.flight: Exits first. Then the rest.|Open lane. Keep your spacing.|Stay where I can count you.
Idra.bossphase.HessaKorl: She's calling crew. Watch your backs.
Idra.bossopening.Cantor: The collar slacks when the song ends. Cut then.
Idra.bossphase.Cantor: New song. New lanes. Read them.
Idra.bossphase.Seedthane: Legs are up. It's circling. Watch the fans.
Idra.bossphase.Floodcrown: Dry floor. Faster. Off the puddles.
Idra.bossopening.Floodcrown: It's stuck in its own wave. Gate, on the rim.
Idra.barge: It's clear. That's cover.|Loose. Use it.|Free. Mind the weed.
Idra.bossphase.Rotbloom: Hall's draining. It's grounded. Watch the floor.
Idra.glow: We're lit. Dark, now.|Too bright. Coast.
Idra.tune: Two short, one long. Set.|Second one. Both in time.
Idra.lure: No long. Not a lamp.|It can't hold the count. Weapons.
Idra.pump: Draining. Watch the alcoves.|It's turning. Stand clear of what wakes.
Idra.bossphase.DessikVarn: He's throwing cargo. Watch the circles.
Idra.foot: Foot's off.|Another. It's limping.|It's running out.
Idra.breach: That's a hull alarm. End this. People are waiting.
Idra.bossphase.HostMarshal: Ring's closing. It's slow now. Don't be under the spear.
Idra.current: Wrong lane. Cross.|Against the current. Don't.
Idra.thaw: Rank's up. Three abreast. Break the middle.
Idra.stray: I don't hum. Walk.|It's following. Don't look round.|Three. Count them yourself, Hask.
Idra.lamp: Lit.|Lit. Long way down.|Last one. Good.
Idra.hail.tender: Tender ahead. Slow to turn, and its wake burns. Cross behind it once.
Idra.hail.fastlane: That's the fast lane. Ride it. It's the only free thing on this ice.
Idra.hail.reach: Stay in my steps. The white holds. The blue is a hole.
Idra.rail: Green. Move.|Amber. Hold in the lee.|Green. On the count.
Idra.rail.forced: Gate forced. Rails are live. Don't sit on one.
Idra.moonshard: Debris on the marked track. Go round. I'm not learning its name.
Idra.lift: It carries. I don't like it. Step on.|Down has moved again.|On. Before I think about it.
Idra.garden: Their bed's broken. They've turned. Shears.
Idra.glassback: Plates are down. Don't step back.
Idra.tender: It's mending the clamp. Tender first.
Idra.clamp: Weight's mine. Cover.|Holding. Watch my back.|Slack. Opening.|Last. On the call.
Idra.mend: Its light came up. Noted.|It's raking again. Twelve paces.|It's moving. Ahead of us. Follow.
Idra.bossphase.LastWarden: Lines are fewer. Floor's wider. Use it.
Idra.bossopening.LastWarden: Staff's grounded. Clamp. I have your back.
Idra.picket.hunters: Stage two. Hunters. Break their line.
Idra.picket.carrier: Carrier's turning. Stage three. We go loud.
Idra.flak: Curtain's timed. Count it. Go on the gap.
Idra.lancer: Lancer. Off the line. Hit it on the turn.
Idra.mortar: Shell on the ring. The ring stays hot.
Idra.sluice: One open.|Two. Press is armed.|Three. Plate's dark.
Idra.kitchen.kettle: Kettle. I've stolen worse for better.
Idra.harbour: Guns mark the water. Stay off the marks.
Idra.bossphase.VessaKorl: She's falling back on the heart. Don't chase.
Idra.bossphase.SlagColossus: Arms gone. It's breaking up. Watch the floor.
Idra.bossphase.DraskSkiff: He's for the carrier. Cut him off at the cranes.
Idra.hail.lock: Port collar. Outer bolts first.|Starboard. Same order.|Keel collar. Slower.|Keeper bar. Now.
Idra.spiral: Inward. Fast. Eyes open.|Outward. Slow. Clear.
Idra.towdrone: Tow-drone. Cut the line, then the drone.
Idra.fragment: Cage fragment. It sweeps on a count. Cross after.
Idra.wreck: Family hull. Mark it.|Lamp lit. Occupied. Mark it.|Marked. Next.
Idra.dawn: Dawn line. Behind. Moving.|Closer. Don't stop.|It's on us. Go.
Idra.scavenger: Burrower. It lunges. Shade breaks it off.
Idra.warden: They're giving ground. Don't chase. They're crew.
Idra.bossphase.FoundrySaint: Rig's on its back. Climb. I'll hold the floor.
Idra.interceptor: Pair. Break the tractor line first.
Idra.section: Repair quarter, passing. In formation.|Crescent's clear of the ring.|Tug dock. Last one. Counted.
Idra.bossphase.DebrisCutter: It's changed its run. New lanes.
Idra.bench.ket: Delivered. Ket had it lit before I'd turned round.
Idra.bench.marn: Delivered. Marn asked nothing. Good sign.
Idra.parcel.crawl: Parcel, Crawl. They didn't stop for it. I respect that.
Idra.hail.ring: Ring's held. Sections, keep your count.|Interceptors on the crescent. I have them.|Nobody breaks formation for me. Fly.

Teo.hail.barge1: Near barge is loose. She was always the easy one. I don't trust it.
Teo.hail.barge2: Second one's out of the mirror's shadow. She'll want thanking. Don't. It goes to her head.
Teo.hail.barge3: Far barge is free. She's carrying the good seed, so of course she went furthest.
Teo.hail.landing: That's three in the lane. The delta beacon's lit. Follow it down before I count something else.

Ruva.rope: Lean into it.|Again. She's coming.|There. She's seated.

Jask.hail.ferry: Surveyor! Is that you? Can you hear me from there?

Maru.hail.pods: Pods ahead. Shoot one and you'll be blind and popular. Thread them.
Maru.hail.swarm: Swarm field. Boost, then coast dark and count two. I can hear you wanting to fire.
Maru.hail.ray: Next beacon's the dark one. A ray circles it. Set the lamp on its far pass, or fight it lit.
Maru.hail.relit: I see it. Keeping time. Cleaner than my apprentice sets them. He's twelve, so don't dress it up.
Maru.hail.gate: Tide-gate's the ring of lamps on the water below. Come down dark. Somebody will throw you a line.
Maru.hail.bright: Lantern. You're glowing. I can see you from my kitchen.
Maru.line: Give. Give. Now keep.|She's pulling. Let her.|There. She's lying easy. You can breathe.
Maru.hail.leech: Marked water's leeches. There's a dry way round. It's longer. Take it.

Dessik.foot: That's hired.|That's also hired.|You're running up a bill.|Note the damage. Somebody note the damage.

Keeper.hail.breach: Breach! The north-west cabins! The door's sealed itself and I can't get it open!

Patrol.hail.latched: Many Hands, Steady Hand. Your hull is open. We are latching on. No declaration is needed.

Vessa.hail.rank1: Rank one is thawed. Forty tonnes. Load it.
Vessa.hail.rank2: Rank two. Load it. The Shapers are eleven minutes of delay. I've entered them.
Vessa.hail.coupling1: You have put two hundred tonnes back in the ice. I'll remember the figure.
Vessa.hail.coupling2: Four hundred. Stop loading rank three. Bring up the lifter.
Vessa.hail.excavator: Excavators to the middle gallery. A thaw-lance melts a rescue frame as well as it melts ice.
Vessa.hail.gallery: Gallery guard, close up. They are three tonnes of trouble.|Pour drones, tip on my mark. I've costed the floor.

Ishen.hail.moon: Number seven is the Bellfounder. I'm sorry. I'll stop.|The Almoner. I didn't say anything.|The ninth is the Warden. It rides last, behind all the others. Now I'll stop.
Ishen.hail.survey: Slower, please. There. The Steward, and its hour beneath.|The Weigher. I have it. You may go quickly now.|The Lamplighter. That's all three. Oh, well flown.

Lume.hail.pod: Courier pod to the Shapers. Lume, flying. He has unbuckled to look at a moon. Fly gently.

Warden.clamp.open: One clamp is opened.|Two clamps are opened.|Three clamps are opened.

Brekk.hail.crust: Dark holds. Step where I step.|That seam's lit. Wait it out.|Squall. Stand still. It passes.

Tovra.hail.sluice: The red wheel. Turn it till it screams.|Second wheel's behind the press. Mind the press.|Third. That plate's going dark. Hit it.

Drask.shout: Guard wing! To me!|Arrek! Sool! To me!|Sool!
Drask.duel: Well struck.|You're better than my reports.|Again. Take your time.
Drask.hail.harbour: Harbour guns, mark them.|Battery two. Battery four. Mark them.|Battery four.

Bryn.hail.spiral: Traffic on the spiral, watch your inside. That was a ferry once.|Nice flying, traffic. Don't get used to it.
Bryn.hail.ring: Section traffic, Welcome Back. Hold your spacing. You're towns, not darts.|Market district, you're drifting. Don't apologise. Correct.

Dorrow.hail.dawn: Dawn's a way behind you yet. Lovely colour. Don't look.|It's gaining. It always does. Nothing personal.|That's it on your heels. I'd run. I'm told you can.
Dorrow.hail.remate: First coupling! Hear her stop complaining?|Second. She's nearly a town again.|Third. That's her. Drive, drive, drive.

Neve.hail.lane: Market to the board. She turns like a warehouse. I've stopped fighting her.|Shapers, keep that cutter off my street.

Mira.hail.market: Market to the board. Something's hit my awning. I want it logged.

Hal.hail.repair: Repair quarter. We're holding together. Easy on the turn, Neve.
